title: sophora velutina subsp. cavaleriei
intro: Sophora velutina subsp. cavaleriei, commonly known as the root of the Sophora plant, is a type of flowering plant in the legume family native to Asia. This plant is valued for its health benefits, particularly in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is used to treat various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Sophora velutina subsp. cavaleriei include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
